news.headline: EU transparency rules for AI take effect
news.body: Article 50 of the EU Artificial Intelligence Act requires providers to label AI-generated content and disclose AI use from August 2, 2026. The new transparency duties aim to curb deepfakes and give users clearer information about how AI systems operate.
